notas: Plane = LOLA south polar stereographic: up = longitude 0°, right = 90° E.
comando: python -m pipeline.terreno generar --id shackleton --cuerpo luna --lat -89.67 --lon 129.78 --lado-km 40.0 --n 1024 --escala sitio --nombre 'Shackleton crater, lunar south pole' --centro-fuente https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/5450 --capas iluminacion,sombra_permanente,temp_max

picos_luz.criterio: 5 pixels of AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608 (60 m) with the highest mean solar illumination whose centre falls in the grid, greedy, each at least 1 km from the previous ones (polar stereographic plane); fila/col = grid cell containing the pixel centre; valor = pixel value
